definitions.x: a fixed oriented root pivot literal sign(x)
definitions.R_new: set of unique non-tautological x-resolvents not already present in the retained raw set
definitions.I_x(r): intersection of signed co-literals over all oriented x-parent generators of r
definitions.W_x: sum w(r) over r in R_new with I_x(r) nonempty
definitions.E_xb: sum w(r) over r in R_new with b in I_x(r)
definitions.B_x: set of nondegenerate signed co-literals b with abs(b)!=x

lemma.statement: sum_{b in B_x} E_xb = sum_{r in R_new} w(r)*|I_x(r)| >= W_x. Therefore max_b E_xb >= W_x/|B_x| >= W_x/(2*(n-1)) whenever n>=2.
proof: By definition E_xb includes r exactly when b belongs to I_x(r).
Interchanging the finite sums counts each r with multiplicity |I_x(r)|, giving the exact first equality.
Every r contributing to W_x has |I_x(r)|>=1, so the sum is at least W_x.
A maximum is at least the average over B_x.
There are at most two signed literals for each of the other n-1 underlying variables, so |B_x|<=2(n-1).

rescue_connection.remaining_need: A lower bound on W_x together with an upper/average bound on star overhead H_xb strong enough to force some rho_xb>=0 on every reachable all-pivot-overflow root state.

adversarial_dual.name: UNFACTORABLE_GENERATOR_INTERSECTION_MASS
adversarial_dual.definition: Z_x=sum w(r) over unique-new resolvents with I_x(r)=empty
adversarial_dual.counterexample_pressure: A candidate hostile to pivot-involving v2 should maximize Z_x and minimize W_x simultaneously across both pivot orientations while retaining all-pivot overflow.
